parameters.name: Organization
parameters.query:
CSEEvents
| where isnotempty(OrgId)
| summarize Count = count(), Name = take_any(OrgName) by OrgId
| order by Count desc
| project Value = OrgId, Label = strcat(Name, " (", Count, ")")

parameters.name: User
parameters.query:
CSEEvents
| where isnotempty(UserEmail)
| summarize Count = count(), Name = take_any(UserEmail) by UserEmail
| order by Count desc
| project Value = UserEmail, Label = strcat(Name, " (", Count, ")")

parameters.name: Device
parameters.query:
CSEEvents
| where isnotempty(DeviceName)
| summarize Count = count(), Name = take_any(DeviceName) by DeviceName
| order by Count desc
| project Value = DeviceName, Label = strcat(Name, " (", Count, ")")

parameters.name: ClientIp
parameters.query:
CSEEvents
| where isnotempty(ClientIp)
| summarize Count = count(), Name = take_any(ClientIp) by ClientIp
| order by Count desc
| project Value = ClientIp, Label = strcat(Name, " (", Count, ")")

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| summarize Events = count() by EventType, bin(EventTime, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Events over time by type

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| summarize Events = count(), LastSeen = max(EventTime) by EventType, EventSubType, Action, Severity
| order by Events desc
content.title: Events by type, subtype, and action

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| extend DelayMinutes = (IngestedAt - EventTime) / 1m
| summarize Median = percentile(DelayMinutes, 50), P95 = percentile(DelayMinutes, 95), Maximum = max(DelayMinutes) by bin(EventTime, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Delay from event to Sentinel (minutes)

content.query:
SentinelHealth
| where SentinelResourceKind == "ApiPolling" and SentinelResourceName endswith "CSEEventsPoller"
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Status, Reason, Description
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Connector health

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where EventType == "Access" and isnotempty(ServiceName)
| summarize Users = dcount(UserEmail), Devices = dcount(DeviceSerialNumber), Connections = countif(Action in ("Connected", "Authorized")), Denials = countif(Action == "Unauthorized"), LastSeen = max(EventTime) by OrgName, ServiceName, EventSubType
| order by Connections desc
content.title: Services accessed

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where (EventType == "Access" and Action == "Unauthorized") or (EventType == "Identity" and Action == "Deny")
| summarize Denials = count(), Reasons = make_set(Message, 5), LastDenial = max(EventTime) by OrgName, UserEmail
| order by Denials desc
| take 25
content.title: Users with the most access denials

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where EventType == "Identity" and isnotempty(ClientCountry)
| summarize Granted = countif(Action == "Grant"), Denied = countif(Action == "Deny"), Users = dcount(UserEmail), LastSeen = max(EventTime) by OrgName, ClientCountry, ClientCity
| order by Denied desc, Granted desc
content.title: Sign-ins by location

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where EventType == "AdminLogin" and Action == "Deny"
| project EventTime, OrgName, UserEmail, EventSubType, ClientIp, ClientUserAgent
| order by EventTime desc
content.title: Failed admin logins

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where EventType == "TrustScoring" and isnotempty(DeviceSerialNumber)
| summarize arg_max(EventTime, TrustLevel, TrustScore, TrustProfileName, FailedFactors, OrgName, UserEmail, DeviceName, DevicePlatform) by DeviceSerialNumber
| project-rename LastEvaluated = EventTime
| order by TrustScore asc
content.title: Current device trust levels

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where EventType == "TrustScoring" and FailedFactorCount > 0
| mv-expand Factor = FailedFactors to typeof(string)
| summarize Evaluations = count(), Devices = dcount(DeviceSerialNumber), LastSeen = max(EventTime) by Factor
| order by Evaluations desc
content.title: Most common failed trust factors

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where isnotempty(DeviceSerialNumber) and isnotempty(DevicePlatform)
| summarize Devices = dcount(DeviceSerialNumber) by DevicePlatform
content.title: Devices by platform

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where EventType in ("Threat", "Compliance", "Malware", "SAASSecurity") and Action == "Denied"
| summarize Blocks = count() by BlockReason, bin(EventTime, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Internet Access blocks over time by reason

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where EventType in ("Threat", "Compliance", "Malware", "SAASSecurity") and Action == "Denied"
| mv-expand Category = split(iff(isempty(UrlCategory), "(none)", UrlCategory), "|") to typeof(string)
| summarize Blocks = count(), Users = dcount(UserEmail), LastSeen = max(EventTime) by Category, BlockReason
| order by Blocks desc
content.title: Internet Access blocks by category and reason

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where EventType in ("Threat", "Compliance", "Malware", "SAASSecurity") and Action == "Denied"
| summarize Events = count(), Users = dcount(UserEmail), LastSeen = max(EventTime) by OrgName, EventType, UrlDomain, BlockReason
| order by Events desc
| take 50
content.title: Internet Access blocks by destination

content.query:
CSEEvents
| where '{Organization:label}' == "All" or OrgId in ({Organization})
| where '{User:label}' == "All" or UserEmail in ({User})
| where '{Device:label}' == "All" or DeviceName in ({Device})
| where '{ClientIp:label}' == "All" or ClientIp in ({ClientIp})
| where EventType == "Malware"
| summarize Events = count(), Users = dcount(UserEmail), LastSeen = max(EventTime) by OrgName, Action, UrlDomain, BlockReason, FileHash
